strings.name: Mo Ibrahim
strings.summary: Born in Sudan, Ibrahim studied electrical engineering and mobile communications in Egypt and Britain and worked in British telecommunications. He founded consultancy MSI and African mobile operator Celtel, turning increasingly to philanthropy after its 2005 sale. His foundation, established in 2006, uses governance indices, leadership prizes and research to advance African public-governance debate, connecting communications infrastructure, data and political accountability.
